name: Dakota Auto Parts
old_description: If you have any comments or general questions, please email us using the form below. For price and availability on parts, or any other product information, please call and talk to our experienced sales staff. Thank you.
about:
Dakota Auto Parts operates from a storefront at 115 North Cliff Avenue in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The business serves the surrounding region with a retail counter and delivery operation, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks and distributes replacement parts and name-brand automotive accessories, advertising overnight availability on many hard-to-find items. In addition to parts sales, the shop provides automotive coatings and truck bed liner applications, striping and molding services, and paint mixing Monday through Friday. A shuttle service runs between local businesses, and the facility maintains regular hours Monday through Saturday.

Customers include automotive and auto body repair shops as well as vehicle owners seeking accessories to enhance appearance or functionality. The staff includes specialists in both mechanical repair and collision work, allowing the business to support professional technicians and retail buyers alike.

Dakota Auto Parts emphasizes its experienced sales team and the ability to source difficult-to-locate components quickly, positioning itself as a local resource for both routine maintenance and specialized repair needs.
